resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to how much "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" box office will gross domestically by September 30, 2026. The "Daily Box Office Performance" figures found on the "Box Office" tab on this movie's The Numbers (https://www.the-numbers.com/) page will be used to resolve this market once the values for all dates between opening (July 31, 2026) and September 30, 2026 are final (i.e., not studio estimates).

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

Please note, this market will resolve according to the The Numbers figures provided under Box Office Performance until and including September 30, 2026, regardless of whether domestic refers to only the USA, or to USA and Canada, etc.

If there is ambiguity as to whether the resolution source's figures are final, this market will remain open until both https://www.boxofficemojo.com/ and https://www.the-numbers.com/ have confirmed their finalized figures.

If there is no final data available by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, another credible resolution source will be chosen.

# Spider-Man: Brand New Day: domestic gross through Sept 30, 2026 (research as of 2026-09-16)

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-09-16: The Numbers' daily Box Office table shows a cumulative domestic total of **$936,773,134 through Sept 15**. That is the latest figure published on or before today. Recent daily grosses:
  - Sept 11: $2,004,897
  - Sept 12: $3,842,610
  - Sept 13: $2,563,236
  - Sept 14: $676,419
  - Sept 15: $915,084 (a Tuesday discount bump)
  
  [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Spider-Man-Brand-New-Day-(2026)#tab=box-office)
- The page also lists rows dated after today. I have ignored them, as the exercise rules require.
- Weekend history from The Numbers: $360.1M (opening Jul 31), $144.3M, $70.7M, $39.0M, $22.5M, $18.2M (Labor Day weekend, Sept 4-6), and $8.41M (Sept 11-13, rank #2). [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Spider-Man-Brand-New-Day-(2026)#tab=box-office)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled yet. To land in each bracket, the film needs this much more over the 15 days from Sept 16 to Sept 30:
  - Clear $940M: about **$3.2M**
  - Reach $950M: about **$13.2M**
  - Reach $960M: about **$23.2M**
  - Reach $970M: about **$33.2M**
- Recent pace:
  - The Sept 11-13 weekend fell 54% from the Labor Day weekend, which was inflated by the holiday.
  - Mon and Tue Sept 14-15 together earned $1.59M, versus $2.50M for Mon-Tue Sept 8-9 (Sept 8 was the day after Labor Day). That is down about 36%.
  - The week of Sept 8-14 earned about $12.4M in total.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-16: Reports say the film passed The Force Awakens to become the all-time #1 domestic release, at about $936.8M. [Digg](https://digg.com/entertainment/6f0d08pg), [Boxoffice Pro](https://www.boxofficepro.com/sony-pictures-spider-man-brand-new-day-becomes-the-highest-grossing-domestic-release-of-all-time/)
- Sept 11-13 weekend: the film fell to #2 with $8.41M. This ended a six-weekend run at #1. [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Spider-Man-Brand-New-Day-(2026)#tab=box-office)
- 2026-09-07: Xinhua reported a sixth straight #1 weekend, adding $18M for a $917.76M total. It was the first film to hold #1 for six weekends since Avatar: The Way of Water. The Odyssey placed second with $13M (total $584.8M), and Coyote vs. Acme third with $11.3M. [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2026/09/07/spider-man-brand-new-day-tops-north-american-box-office-for-6th-straight-weekend)
- Early August: the opening weekend set a domestic record. The studio estimated $355M, and the actual was $360.1M, beating Endgame's $357M. [tbreak](https://tbreak.com/spider-man-brand-new-day-beats/)

## 4. Base rates and trend
- Weekend-to-weekend drops so far:
  - Weekend 2 to 3: about -51%
  - Weekend 3 to 4: -45%
  - Weekend 4 to 5: -42%
  - Weekend 5 to 6: -19% (Labor Day)
  - Weekend 6 to 7: -54% (post-holiday)
- Mid-to-late September is usually the weakest stretch of the year. Late-run blockbusters typically drop about 30-45% a week without a holiday.
- Illustrative arithmetic only, not a forecast. If the run drops about 35-45% a week from the week of Sept 8-14 (about $12.4M), the 15 days from Sept 16 to Sept 30 would add very roughly $10-15M. Faster decay, for example from losing premium (PLF/IMAX) screens, would mean less. Slower decay would mean more.
- As far as I could tell, the earlier weekdays (Sept 8-10: $1.50M, $1.00M, $0.80M) set the scale for late-September weekdays, which are likely well under $1M each.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices for the Sept 30 market specifically.
- A related Polymarket market, "total domestic gross by August 31", existed. In early August, reports put the odds of passing $900M by Aug 31 at about 73%. [polymarkets mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/hi/market/spider-man-brand-new-day-total-domestic-gross-by-august-31-20260716181307512/), [odaily](https://www.odaily.news/en/newsflash/506572)
- PopCulture cited betting markets giving about an 11% chance of a $1B domestic total. I could not confirm the article's date. [PopCulture](https://popculture.com/entertainment/news/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office/)
- I found no analyst projections of the domestic total on a fixed date.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Weekends of Sept 18-20 and Sept 25-27: these two weekends plus the weekday totals will decide the bracket. Saturdays have recently made up about 45% of weekend gross.
- New competition: a fall preview lists a Sept 18 release, though the blurb's title and plot look garbled. A Sony wide release on Sept 11 and Practical Magic 2 (listed as Sept 11) are already in play. I could not confirm the Sept 25 wide releases. [Boston.com](https://www.boston.com/culture/entertainment/2026/09/17/fall-movie-preview-2026/), [Box Office Mojo calendar](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/calendar/2026-08-14/?area=SG)
- Watch for lost IMAX/PLF screens, Tuesday discount bumps, and any marketing pushes such as re-releases or bonus content tied to the record.
- Resolution timing: the daily figures for Sept 30 should be final by about Oct 1-2. The Numbers sometimes revises weekend estimates to actuals on Monday.
